name: dev.repowise/repowise
title: Repowise
description: Codebase intelligence for AI coding agents — graph, git history, docs, decisions, code health.

packageArguments.description: The repowise CLI subcommand that starts the MCP server

Path to the repository to serve, indexed first with `repowise init`. Optional: if omitted, the server serves the nearest indexed repository at or above the working directory, falling back to the working directory itself when there is none.
